## Website change alert
Every 30 minutes: loads your pages and posts to Discord when one changes, or when a phrase like "In stock" appears or "Sold out" disappears.

1. Edit **Pages to watch** (one line per page).
2. Paste your Discord webhook URL in **Post to Discord**.
3. **Activate** the workflow. The first run only remembers each page, so nothing is posted. n8n only saves that memory in active runs, so manual test runs always look like a first run.

A page that fails to load 3 checks in a row is reported once. Lines that only moved (ranking lists) don't count. Telegram, Slack, email and pages that need a browser-like user agent: see the Python version.
